posts.coverText: 5 late night questions to ask him

slideText.text: What's something you've been scared to tell me because you weren't sure how I'd react?
If you could change one thing about how you grew up, what would it be and why?
What's the biggest fear you have about our relationship that you've never said out loud?
When you imagine us five years from now, what does that picture look like in your mind?
What's a moment with me that you replay in your mind when you need to smile?

posts.coverText: 5 tricky questions for your boyfriend: the ultimate test

slideText.text: If I asked you to hang out less with one specific friend, would you want to know why first or just do it?
Would you rather I tell you every time a guy hits on me or keep it to myself?
If you had to choose between being right or making me happy, in this moment, which would you pick?
Do you think you put more effort into our relationship than I do, or is it equal?
If I told you I want to take a break right now, what would your first thought be: relief or panic?
